item.title: After $100M cut, Naples estate returns at $195M; why the luxury home remains unsold
item.description: Gordon Pointe, a Naples waterfront estate, is now listed for $195 million. This price represents a $100 million reduction from its initial listing. The property was assembled over decades by financier John Donahue. Its location offers extensive beach frontage and a private yacht basin. The estate remains one of the nation's most expensive homes.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: San Francisco minted just 24 dimes in 1894; 9 survive, and one sold for $1.25 million in 2026
item.description: A rare 1894-S Barber dime has just sold for over one million dollars, reflecting its extraordinary scarcity. Out of the original twenty-four minted in San Francisco, only nine have survived to present day. This coin, steeped in historical intrigue, stands as a numismatic gem and an investment of significant worth due to its limited supply.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Sundar Pichai’s IIT batchmate became a famous monk; what he told him when they met years later
item.description: Sundar Pichai, the CEO of Google, and Gauranga Das, an ISKCON monk, were IIT classmates back in 1993. Decades later, they reunited to explore their divergent journeys. Pichai leads a globally recognized tech powerhouse known for its stress-laden environment, while Das embraces a tranquil, faith-driven life. Their engaging conversation showcased the variety of success stories stemming from their shared educational background.
item.dc:creator: TOI Lifestyle Desk

item.title: 160-year-old St Louis church survives fire, condemnations and legal battle as residents take over restoration
item.description: Once deemed condemned, a 160-year-old church in St. Louis has been granted a new lease on life following a legal battle. Thanks to the Soulard Restoration Group’s successful court order, rehabilitation efforts can now commence. The St. Louis Receivership Group will finance the repairs, while local advocates are determined to protect the historic site from being torn down.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Iowa County’s wind turbines turn into $2.71 million for roads, bridges and schools
item.description: In Howard County, wind turbines have emerged as a significant revenue stream for public finances. The impressive $2.7 million generated in tax revenue supports vital infrastructure, such as bridges and roads, as well as local educational institutions. This funding helps sustain developments without placing the financial burden on residents. Additionally, land-lease agreements with developers provide farmers with a valuable source of income, enhancing the county's economic landscape.

item.title: Union soldier aged 16 to 19 found 162 years after Manassas; now set for Arlington burial
item.description: Archaeological findings at Manassas National Battlefield Park have led to the discovery of a young Union soldier's remains, believed to have been between 16 and 19 years old when he fought in 1862. The remains included four amputated limbs, shedding light on historical medical practices during war. To honor this fallen hero, his remains will be laid to rest at Arlington National Cemetery, preserving the legacy of the Civil War.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Brazil’s 200 million termite mounds have formed over 4,000 years from soil termites dug up
item.description: Millions of ancient termite mounds dot Brazil's landscape, concealing a vast underground tunnel system. These structures, some nearly four thousand years old, represent immense ecosystem engineering by termites. The insects excavated extensive tunnels to access food in seasonally dry forests. This process created millions of evenly spaced cones over generations of work. The resulting pattern showcases a hidden subterranean system and its ancient origins.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Former NASA specialist claims he has found a way to overcome Earth's gravity in a 'major discovery'
item.description: A former engineer from NASA has made an exciting claim regarding propulsion technology. His company has engineered a device that generates thrust purely through electric fields, without expelling any mass. This groundbreaking technology has shown consistent improvements in force generation over several years. Upcoming space demonstrations are expected to exhibit the full potential of this cutting-edge innovation.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: At 21, an Australian artist bought 25 acres in Tasmania; 18 months later a bushfire...
item.description: After a devastating bushfire, an Australian artist turned adversity into creativity by reconstructing her home from salvaged materials. Over several months, she gathered timber and metal sheets, crafting a self-sufficient cabin for just AU$7,000 to AU$10,000. The dwelling features off-grid systems powered by solar panels and rainwater tanks, presenting a viable low-cost housing option for younger Australians seeking sustainable living.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: In 2008, Larry Page demolished 2 Palo Alto homes; a year later, he planned a 6,000-sq-ft eco-home
item.description: In the late 2000s, Google co-founder Larry Page purchased nearby parcels in Palo Alto, leading to plans for a sprawling 6,000-square-foot home designed with nature in mind. This remarkable dwelling was set to showcase sustainable innovations like solar panels and a garden atop the roof. Yet, the construction sparked controversy regarding the preservation of neighborhood integrity in light of new developments.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Western troops in Ukraine would mean war with Russia’: Putin ahead of Brics meet
item.description: President Putin warned that the presence of foreign troops in Ukraine would escalate into war with Russia. He refuted claims that Russia poses a threat to European countries, stating that previous disagreements have been settled. Furthermore, he pointed out that the current challenges facing Europe stem from significant political and economic miscalculations by the West.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey
